result.instructions: Tools for Facturalia, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create an invoice for ACME BV: 10 hours of consulting at €120 per hour, 21% VAT, payable in 30 days."; "Has invoice VF20260215 been paid and sent yet?"; "Create a credit note for the order 12345, reference the original invoice number in the note.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Facturalia data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run facturalia_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run facturalia_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run facturalia_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. facturalia_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: facturalia_get_invoice_status
tools.title: Get invoice status
tools.description: Get the sent and paid status of one invoice by its number. Facturalia API: GET /invoices/status/?number=.

number.description: The document number, exactly as Facturalia shows it (for example VF20260215).

tools.name: facturalia_get_credit_note_status
tools.title: Get credit note status
tools.description: Get the paid status of one credit note by its number. Facturalia API: GET /creditnotes/status/?number=.

number.description: The document number, exactly as Facturalia shows it (for example VF20260215).

tools.name: facturalia_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: Create a sales invoice in the live Facturalia account from customer and line data. It creates a real invoice that counts toward the account's invoices; it is not sent by e-mail (autosend is not offered). Send external_id so a retry does not create a second invoice. Facturalia API: POST /invoices/.

external_id.description: Your own unique reference for this document. Send it on every create: the same external_id with the same body returns the same document; with a different body the API returns a conflict.

number.description: Own document number. Omit it to let Facturalia number the document (recommended).

reference.description: Free reference, for example the order number.

is_sent.description: 1 marks the document as sent. This does not send it.

update_customer.description: 1 updates the stored customer data when the customer already exists.

update_products.description: 1 updates the stored product data when the product already exists.

due_days.description: Payment term in days from the invoice date.

external_customer_no.description: Facturalia customer number (the customer's number in Facturalia).

vat_number.description: VAT number, for example BE0123456789. Used to find an existing customer first.

country.description: ISO-2 country code, for example BE.

email.description: Billing e-mail address. Used to find an existing customer if the VAT number finds none.

customer.description: The customer. Give at least one of vat_number, name or external_customer_no.

product_code.description: Product code. An existing product keeps its stored data on the invoice.

unit.description: Unit name exactly as in Facturalia (default: stuks).

product_group.description: Product group name exactly as in Facturalia.
